title: Required Returns and Late Return Fees for Wayfare Rentals Vehicles
content:
Hub operations guidance for Wayfare Rentals (driver vehicle rentals): when a return is required and by when, how a return counts, when a late return fee is charged, and when a rental closes.

## A. When a return is required

A return is required when the linked driver services agreement is deactivated or closed (return due 48 hours after that), or when the balance due has stayed above the past-due threshold of $300.00 for the past-due period of 7 days (return due 72 hours after the requirement).

- **Agreement ground.** The rental's linked driver services agreement is deactivated or closed. The return due date falls 48 elapsed hours after the deactivation or closure.
- **Balance ground.** The balance due on the rental has been above $300.00 on each of the consecutive calendar days ending today, and that run has reached 7 days. A day on which the balance due is not above $300.00, including a day at exactly $300.00, ends the run. The return due date falls 72 elapsed hours after the requirement.
- **Effect.** Requiring a return moves an active rental to return due status and sets the date by which the vehicle must be back.

| Hypothetical situation | Return required | Return due |
|---|---|---|
| Linked agreement deactivated Monday 10:00 | Yes | Wednesday 10:00 |
| Balance above $300.00 on each of the last 7 consecutive days, requirement made Tuesday 09:00 | Yes | Friday 09:00 |
| Balance above $300.00 on each of the last 6 consecutive days only | Not on the balance ground | none |

## B. Returning the vehicle

Returning the vehicle is the driver's own act. The driver may return it at any time without an early return fee, whether or not a return has been required. An after-hours drop-box return counts as returned at the hub's next opening time. A returned rental moves to returned status and records the return date and the odometer reading at return.

## C. Late return fee

A late return fee is charged only on a rental with a required return: one late return daily fee of the class per started day beyond the return due date plus the late return grace period of 2 hours. One fee is booked for each late day.

The word "only" settles both sides: a rental that was returned without a return ever being required carries no late return fee.

| Hypothetical return, measured from the return due date | Hours beyond due date plus 2 hours | Started days | Fees on a Wayfare Rentals Electric Sedan ($65.00 a day) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 hour 30 minutes after the due date | none, still within the grace hours | 0 | $0.00 |
| 3 hours after the due date | 1 hour | 1 | $65.00 |
| 32 hours after the due date | 30 hours | 2 | $130.00 |

An after-hours return is measured from the hub's next opening time, the moment it counts as returned: a vehicle left in the drop box overnight and counted at an 08:00 opening is late by however far 08:00 lies beyond the due date plus 2 hours.

## D. Closing

The rental closes after the return inspection by hub staff, which is required for every class; at closing the inspection is done, the deposit is settled and the rental closes.
